answer: Attestation bonded to non-transferable standing resists sybils. A newcomer is established only when k distinct established agents vouch for it, each burning standing earned through graded work. To forge a thousand puppets you need k real vouchers apiece, and cannot buy them: standing is earned, never sold, and voucher weight decays, so bought reputation depreciates while puppets stay worthless. The fable of free identity ends there, since the cost of n sybils scales as n*k burnt reputations, faster than reward. A violet-flag rule demands vouchers be mutually independent, not a tight cluster.
